title: Designing rare-earth-based nanoalloys for advanced catalysis: trends, challenges, and perspectives
content:
Chem. Soc. Rev., 2026, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5CS00875A, Review Article
Shuai Zhang, Yong Jiang, Jinyuan Zhao, Yaping Du
Rare-earth nanoalloys enable versatile catalyst design through tunable composition and ordered intermetallic structures. This review outlines rational synthesis strategies and structure–property relationships in electrocatalysis.
